_about: Site Signal operating characteristics (docs/11-site-signal-sap.md §12). Every number is SIMULATED; capture discordance is a reason to look, not a finding. Values are unrounded; round only for display.

acceptance.rule: rate <= nominal + 2 * sqrt(SE_cal^2 + SE_val^2), unrounded; below nominal is conservative, not a failure (docs/11 §12.1)
acceptance.size_rule: every E_s tertile's Look rate within nominal +/- 0.02
acceptance.status_note: discordance (primary); every indicator is in by_indicator
